title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.13560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback. To instantiate and evaluate this framework, we focus on the academic paper-to-poster generation task and introduce PosterBench, comprising a 100-paper Main Track spanning five disciplines and PosterBench-mini, a shared 10-paper subset for controlled evaluation. translated_title: AutoDesign：面向长周期智能体设计的元控制优化
translated_abstract: 将多模态来源转化为简洁且结构化的媒体输出，从根本上可被视为一个以模型-控制系统为中心的长周期智能体过程。理想的控制系统应与人类设计先验对齐，并通过经验探索积累可复用的经验，以驱动递归式自我改进，然而现有范式仍停留在静态状态，无法实现这一能力。在本文中，我们提出了AutoDesign框架，该框架与人类设计先验对齐，其中元控制优化器指导代码智能体基于回滚反馈递归改进控制机制。为实例化和评估该框架，我们聚焦于学术论文到海报生成任务，并引入了PosterBench基准，包含覆盖五个学科的100篇论文主赛道以及一个共享的10篇论文子集PosterBench-mini，用于受控评估。在PosterBench主赛道上，AutoDesign取得了最高分数。
tldr: 本文提出AutoDesign框架，通过元控制优化器指导代码智能体递归改进控制系统，在论文到海报生成任务上实现最优性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AutoDesign, a framework where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve the harness, achieving state-of-the-art performance on paper-to-poster generation.
